idea: Burning methane breaks C–H and O=O bonds, which takes energy in, then makes stronger C=O and O–H bonds, which gives out more, so the reaction releases energy.

parameters.name: progress
parameters.why: From the reactants, through broken bonds and moving atoms, to the products.

parameters.name: activation
parameters.why: A low to a high hump, to show the activation energy does not change the energy released.

moves: The reactants' bonds fade, the atoms glide to their places in carbon dioxide and water, and the new bonds appear, while a ball climbs over the hump of the energy profile and drops to the products.
steps: The bonds holding the reactants together
Making stronger bonds gives energy out
The activation energy does not change the energy released
